caption: Autumn leaves come loose from a tree on a still afternoon and drift down to settle on the lawn.

sa.check: Leaves come loose from a tree.
They drift down through the air.
The afternoon is still: the tree and the grass are not being blown about.
The leaves come loose first and the drifting down follows.

pc.expect: Every leaf ends lower than it started, fluttering and turning on the way but never climbing back toward the branch.
pc.fail: A leaf rises back up toward the branches; or a leaf hangs still in mid-air; or a leaf travels upward out of the frame.

pc.expect: The leaves fall slowly, swinging from side to side, each one on its own path.
pc.fail: The leaves drop straight and fast like stones; or they all fall together as one rigid sheet; or a leaf gathers speed until it streaks downward.

pc.expect: Leaves come away from the tree and stay put once they are on the lawn; on a still afternoon nothing sweeps them about.
pc.fail: A settled leaf lifts off the lawn again with nothing touching it; or leaves are driven sideways as if in a gale while the tree stands still; or a leaf turns sharply in the open air.

pc.expect: The leaves stay thin and flexible, curling and turning in the air and lying flat on the grass.
pc.fail: A leaf stays rigid like a board for its whole fall; or a leaf bounces off the lawn like a ball; or a leaf shatters where it lands.

pc.expect: The leaves keep their number: none appear in mid-air and none disappear.
pc.fail: Leaves appear in the air with no branch above them; or a falling leaf vanishes before reaching the lawn; or a leaf passes through a branch or through the ground.

pc.expect: The leaves' colours, the tree and the lawn stay the same.
pc.fail: A leaf changes colour as it falls; or the tree's foliage changes colour between frames; or the lawn behind rearranges.
